propositions: One environment variable cannot express four passes; the code-review gate's five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) cannot each declare their required model class (frontier for Pass-1, standard for Pass-2/Pass-4) when provider-aware configuration is required.

The verifier downgrade mechanism (per-provider downgrade from frontier/opus to standard/sonnet on Pass-2/Pass-4) is unreachable or inverted on non-default providers because per-step model declarations are ignored at runtime and all steps inherit the single cfg.model scalar.

Step-level model declarations in code-review.yaml are currently a no-op for batch steps because the batch runner path never reads the step's model key, only the batch sub-dict's model_ladder; the declarations for base and coach are similarly not reaching the resolver during gate execution.

Bedrock cutover (story eb6e) cannot proceed with one cfg.model knob because opus-everywhere fails Pass-2 with temperature deprecation error, sonnet-everywhere silently downgrades Pass-1, and parity comparison (story 0d76) is unattributable across provider and per-pass model variables.
